messages:
anya: Quick callout 1 - we need to finalize the reserved-pool burst shaping and telemetry plan for GA. Marketing wants one-page copy, Legal wants exact expiry verbiage, and SRE is demanding shed controls.
tom: Short list of decisions we still need: credit rollover semantics, guaranteed micro-window length, default throttling behavior, and required audit endpoints.
zara: From CS: pilots (AcmePilot, FinchRetail) hate surprise bills. They prefer a visible rewind/rollover + email notice. Recommend: monthly rollover up to 100% cap, with 7-day expiry notice.
pavan: Engineering caveat: supporting accurate rollover requires an eventually-consistent ledger. We'll guarantee accuracy within 30s of issuance; explain in docs. Also prefer ledger write batching to reduce contention.
simon: SRE asks: two ops APIs must exist at GA: POST /admin/tenants/{id}/shed?mode=throttle and POST /admin/tenants/{id}/evict?mode=drain. Both must emit audit event tags: ops_action and caller_id.
anya: For throttling semantics: default policy should be soft-throttle (reject after N retries with explanatory error) rather than hard-drop. We need to document exact HTTP error and retry-shape.
tom: Proposal for default knobs (draft):
```json
{
  "contracted_burst_window_s": "30",
  "monthly_rollover_cap_pct": "100",
  "credit_expiry_cycles": "1",
  "default_throttle_policy": "soft-429-backoff"
}
```
zara: Legal request: exact phrasing for expiry. Draft: "Unused burst credits roll over to the following billing cycle up to the monthly cap. Credits not redeemed within one invoicing cycle after rollover will expire unless otherwise stated in the customer's contract." Is that acceptable?
pavan: That's implementable. We'll attach a meter delta metric and an expiry event so billing can reconcile. Metric names: reserved_burst_issued_total, reserved_burst_redeemed_total, reserved_burst_expired_total, reserved_burst_reconcile_diff.
simon: For rollout gates: dark launch behind feature flag, opt-in canary (3 tenants), metric gates for full rollout: 95p latency < 300ms, increase in burst_retry_rate < 0.5% net, billing_reconcile_diff_ratio < 0.002 over 24h. If any gate fails, auto-fallback to soft-throttle and rollback to flag-off.
anya: Can we add a per-tenant telemetry tag: burst_source=[contracted|earned|on_demand] so CS can filter? Also add cause tags: spill_cause=[preemptive|capacity].
tom: Good. I'll add those labels to spans and metrics. Raj (cc not in thread) will need to update per-route dashboard tiles for 95p, burst_retries, prewarm_usage.
zara: Customer comms: I'll draft a short FAQ: "What happens when you hit the cap?" -> "Soft-throttle + clear billing notice + oncall grant process." Also include an SLA add-on option for guaranteed micro-window (e.g., one 30s 2x burst/day).
pavan: Implementation note: contracted micro-window will be implemented with a lease token server-side that enforces duration and emits redemption audit. We'll build admin hooks to grant/revoke.
simon: Ops-runbook snippets to include in launch checklist: page SRE lead if >2 tenants hit hard-cap in 5m, use /admin/tenants/{id}/shed with reason, and run reconcile job. Add Prom alerts for reserved_burst_expired_total spike.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled-canary reserved-pools-burst-shaping v1 on staging at 2025-09-02T04:00Z (will post status).
anya: Next steps: (1) Tom - RFC for default knobs + error code semantics (due Thu), (2) Pavan - ledger/expiry implementation RFC + dedupe tokens (due Thu), (3) Simon - ops APIs & runbook PR (due Thu), (4) Zara - comms + legal expiry wording review (due Thu). Review Fri 11am.
tom: One more edge case - cross-region spill: ensure fair-share algorithm considers region affinity to avoid flapping. Adding to RFC.
zara: I'll ask AcmePilot if they want the SLA add-on; will report back.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary completed - 0 failures.
anya: Great. We should avoid promising >1 guaranteed window/day unless contractually agreed. Marking "contracted-burst-window" as enterprise add-on in backlog. Meeting Friday to finalize. :thumbsup:
